output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function always uses the setPrices function to set the sellPrice and buyPrice, but the setPrices function does not allow the owner to set the prices.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated as `msg.value / sellPrice`, but the sellPrice is never initialized.
The mintToken function has an access control flaw where the owner's address can be changed arbitrarily.
